name: clerk-shadcn-theme
summary: CSS theme that syncs Clerk's prebuilt components with shadcn/ui styles, with an optional dark mode setup.
description: A stylesheet you paste into your global CSS so Clerk's prebuilt authentication components match your shadcn/ui theme. The README lists support for SignIn, SignUp, UserButton, UserProfile, OrganizationSwitcher and other Clerk components; set up your theme (dark mode is optional) and the provided styles do the sync. MIT licensed.
contains: CSS styles for Clerk's prebuilt components
supports SignIn, SignUp, UserButton, UserProfile and OrganizationSwitcher
copy-paste into your global CSS file
